snippet.title: Portentum - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The cryptid deck-building auto battler. Hunt for broken combos using cryptids from around the world like Bigfoot, Jimothy, Nessie, and the Chupacabra. If somebody's uncle saw it in the woods in 1973, there's a good chance it's a card in Portentum.

https://portentum.game
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4836460/Portentum/
